newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL BEAT NORTHERN TRANSVAAL BY 286 RUNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL BEAT NORTHERN TRANSVAAL BY 286 RUNS.

text.p: victory by 286 runs over Northern Transvaal on the final day of
the Supersport Series match at Centurion Park on Monday.
Set an unlikely 501 to win Northerns, resuming at their
overnight score of 129 for three, were bowled out for 214 on the
National all rounder Shaun Pollock finished with five for 48
to show that he has made a full recovery from the heel injury
which prevented him from touring India.
The fourth wicket stand worth 91 overnight between Mike
Rindel and Richie Richardson was finally broken by Pollock after
Pollock trapped Rindel lbw for 60 made off 121 balls with
eight fours. Pollock struck again in his next over to have Dan
van Zyl caught behind for a duck, after gloving a bouncer.
Northern's last hope of saving the game departed when
Richardson was bowled by left arm seamer Gary Gilder for 68. The
former West Indies captain was never fluent and needed 149 balls
to score his runs, hitting 11 fours and a six in the process.
M.van Jaarsfeld c sub b Gilder 0
D.van Zyl c Forde b Pollock 0
Result: Natal beat Northern Transvaal by 286 runs
